characterization_methods.key_findings: Metallic (nonzero DOS at Fermi level); sharp DOS peak at the Fermi level formed mainly by Fe-d and Mn-d states (Mn-d relatively more prominent for Fe0.25Mn0.75Al); band from -5 to 1 eV mainly from Al-p, Fe-d and Mn-d states; magnetic character from asymmetric up/down DOS.
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: energy range -10 to 20 eV; Fermi level at 0 eV (dashed line)
characterization_methods.purpose: Analyze chemical bonding characteristics and electronic structure
characterization_methods.technique: Spin-polarized total and partial density of states (TDOS/PDOS) calculation

characterization_methods.key_findings: Combination of covalent and metallic bonding; covalent interactions along Al-Fe, Al-Mn and Fe-Mn bond axes.
characterization_methods.technique: Electron density distribution (total and difference) contour maps

analytical_models.model_note: Bulk modulus B=(C11+2C12)/3; shear modulus G and Young's modulus E and Poisson's ratio σ computed from VRH averaging of Voigt and Reuss bounds.
H_V = 2(k²G)^0.585 - 3, with k = G/B (Pugh's modulus ratio).
Universal anisotropic index A^U, bulk anisotropy A_B, shear anisotropy A_G, and shear anisotropic factors A1=A2=A3=4C44/(2C11-2C12).

analytical_models.model_name: Debye temperature and sound velocity equations
analytical_models.model_note: Θ_D = (h/k_B)[3n/(4π)(N_A ρ/M)]^(1/3) v_m; v_m, v_l and v_s computed from B, G and ρ.

computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: 8x8x8 Monkhorst-Pack k-point mesh; 450 eV plane-wave cutoff; total energy converged to 2x10^-6 eV; forces < 0.5 eV·nm⁻¹
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Calculated lattice parameters show good agreement with other experimental and calculated values (slight deviation attributed to differences in calculation methods and experimental conditions).

processing_steps.method: First-principles DFT geometry optimization and property calculation (CASTEP, GGA-PBE)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Geometry-optimized crystal structure via first-principles DFT using CASTEP; GGA-PBE exchange-correlation; ultrasoft pseudopotentials; 8x8x8 Monkhorst-Pack k-point mesh; 450 eV plane-wave cutoff; total energy converged to 2x10^-6 eV; forces < 0.5 eV·nm⁻¹. Valence states: Fe 3d⁶4s², Mn 3d⁵4s², Al 3s²3p¹.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: First-principles DFT (CASTEP, GGA-PBE); polycrystalline elastic moduli evaluated via Voigt-Reuss-Hill approximation
Theoretical (DFT) values; Debye temperature and sound velocities calculated from elastic moduli and density via Eqs. (15)-(18)

electrical_properties.electronic_conductivity: good electronic conductivity (metallic character: nonzero DOS at Fermi level)

magnetic_properties.magnetic_character: magnetic characteristics due to dissymmetric spin-up/spin-down DOS

phases_present.crystal_structure: cubic (Pm-3m), B2-type FeAl superstructure with Mn on the Fe sublattice

structures.overall_structure: Cubic supercell structure with space group Pm-3m, based on B2-type FeAl; Mn substitutes for Fe on the Fe sublattice. Fe0.25Mn0.75Al contains 2 Fe, 6 Mn and 8 Al per 16-atom cell (DFT-optimized lattice parameter a = b = c = 0.581 nm).

unmapped_findings: Lattice parameter (DFT-optimized cubic cell): a = b = c = 0.581 nm (space group Pm-3m).
Cohesive energy E_coh = -6.794 eV·atom⁻¹ (negative, thermodynamically stable).
Formation enthalpy ΔH_r = -0.309 eV·atom⁻¹ (negative, thermodynamically stable).
Elastic constants: C11 = 237.9 GPa, C12 = 141.0 GPa, C44 = 134.6 GPa.
Bulk modulus B = 173.3 GPa; shear modulus G = 89.4 GPa; Poisson's ratio σ = 0.280; B/G = 1.94.
B/G = 1.94 > 1.75, indicating ductile behavior (unlike FeAl and Fe0.875Mn0.125Al, which are brittle).
Anisotropy indices: universal anisotropic index A^U = 1.36; bulk anisotropy A_B = 0; shear anisotropy A_G = 0.120; shear anisotropic factors A1 = A2 = A3 = 2.78.
Strong Young's-modulus anisotropy on the (001) and (110) planes (non-spherical planar contours).
Electronic structure: -5 to 1 eV band mainly from Al-p, Fe-d and Mn-d states; Fermi surface dominated by Fe-d and Mn-d with low Al-p states.
Bonding: combination of covalent and metallic bonds, leading to good electronic conductivity, high melting points and high hardness.
Mechanically stable: satisfies cubic mechanical stability criteria (C11-C12>0, C11>0, C44>0, C11+2C12>0).
